players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Andy Reid called him day-to-day with a right (throwing) elbow strain/sprain after the Nov. 8 win over the Jets and described it as minor; Mahomes says he will follow his usual prep for Sunday at Atlanta. His Wednesday Nov. 11 practice participation had not been reported yet.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.note: X-rays on his left (non-throwing) middle finger were negative, and Jim Harbaugh said Nov. 9 he 'should be good to go' for Week 10 MNF at Baltimore. Sleeper still lists him questionable.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Remains week-to-week with a hamstring strain and is listed doubtful as of Nov. 11; Minnesota will reassess him ahead of Week 10 vs. Green Bay. Carson Wentz was benched in the Nov. 9 loss to Buffalo, so the Vikings' QB plan for Week 10 is unsettled.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as MIN's starting QB as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart has listed the rookie No. 1 pick as Las Vegas' starting QB since Nov. 10, with Kirk Cousins no longer on the Raiders. He would make his first start in Week 10 vs. Seattle.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart has listed him as Arizona's starting QB since Nov. 10, after Jacoby Brissett was dealt to Baltimore. Earlier reports had Gardner Minshew starting with Beck promoted to backup, so his Week 10 role is not confirmed.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: After being dealt from Arizona to Baltimore before the Nov. 10 deadline, he is the Ravens' starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He hosts the Chargers in Week 10 on MNF.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He is on IR after right thumb surgery and likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting for Baltimore.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as PHI's backup QB as of 8:00 AM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Seattle ruled him out Nov. 9 for Week 10 at Las Vegas (quad, ribs). Because of the Week 11 bye, Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: He is expected to start Week 10 at Las Vegas with Sam Darnold out. Mike Macdonald said Nov. 9 that Lock's exam (oblique, sore elbow) went well, but Sleeper still lists him questionable.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as CLE's starting QB as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Shedeur Sanders
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as CLE's backup QB as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as MIA's backup QB as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's starting QB as of 8:00 AM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: LaFleur said Jacobs needs surgery this week on the fractured right ring finger from Nov. 8 and did not rule out IR. Reports put the absence at up to about 3 weeks, and he is expected to miss Week 10 vs. Minnesota.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Johnson handled the carries and scored his first NFL TD on Nov. 8 with MarShawn Lloyd inactive. With Josh Jacobs set for finger surgery and likely out several weeks, he is one of Green Bay's top healthy backs, though Pierre Strong Jr. is also expected to be involved.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: The Patriots had no update after his knee MRIs as of Nov. 9, and Sleeper lists him doubtful for Week 10 vs. Detroit in Germany as of Nov. 11.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Henderson has missed two games after being hospitalized with unexplained neurological symptoms. He is now listed questionable (illness) for Week 10 as of Nov. 11, and he could lead New England's backfield with Rhamondre Stevenson doubtful.

players.name: Corey Kiner
players.note: Reports say Kiner would take over as New England's lead back in Week 10 vs. Detroit if Rhamondre Stevenson (knee, doubtful) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness, questionable) both sit.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: The Jets kept Hall through the Nov. 10 trade deadline despite calls from other teams. He stays in a 1-2 split with Braelon Allen, in which Hall took the lead touches in his Nov. 8 return.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: The Jets did not trade Breece Hall before the Nov. 10 deadline, so Allen stays the No. 2 back behind him.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: The Colts kept Taylor through the Nov. 10 deadline, and the Giants reportedly pulled their offer. He stays Indianapolis' lead back.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: Jonathan Taylor was not traded at the Nov. 10 deadline, so McGowan stays a change-of-pace back without the lead-back upside a deal would have opened.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: Skattebo (hamstring) was upgraded to a full practice on the Giants' report ahead of TNF vs. Washington on Nov. 12 and is off Sleeper's injury report, so he is set to return.

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practiced fully this week and is set to return for TNF on Nov. 12, which should end Singletary's 62-snap workload from Week 9.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Upgraded to questionable (groin) for Week 10 as of Nov. 11 after missing three straight games, so a return is possible.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks has led Houston's backfield (46 snaps on Nov. 8), but David Montgomery (groin) was upgraded to questionable on Nov. 11 and could cut into his work in Week 10.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) is listed questionable for Week 10 as of Nov. 11 after missing two straight games.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman played 58 snaps to J.K. Dobbins' 11 on Nov. 8 and remains Denver's clear RB1 while RJ Harvey is on IR.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played just 11 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 58 on Nov. 8 and is now a change-of-pace back.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR, and Jonah Coleman's lead role makes a reduced role likely when he returns.

players.name: Audric Estime
players.note: With Travis Etienne Jr. on IR, Estime played 35 snaps to Alvin Kamara's 37 in Week 9 and outscored him 14.2 to 6.4 half-PPR points. That makes it a near-even split in New Orleans.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (toe) is expected back in Week 11, after Chicago's bye.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Claiborne was moved to injured reserve (knee) on Nov. 9.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) remains on IR after missing three straight games.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight is listed questionable (concussion) for Week 10 as of Nov. 11.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: The 49ers neither traded nor released Aiyuk by the Nov 10 deadline, despite reports that a release was likely. Instead, they traded for Keenan Allen that day. A two-game roster exemption gives SF until about Nov 23 to activate, trade or cut him, and most reports still expect a release.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) is questionable. Kyle Shanahan said he could return to practice Wednesday, Nov 11, after missing the past three games. On Nov 10, SF also acquired Keenan Allen from the Colts for a 2027 sixth-round pick.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
players.note: On Nov 10, the 49ers traded a 2027 sixth-round pick for Keenan Allen (40-351-1 this season), and Deebo Samuel could return to practice Nov 11. Both moves threaten Robinson's snaps.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: Indianapolis traded Josh Downs to Kansas City and Keenan Allen to San Francisco on Nov 10. That leaves Burks, Laquon Treadwell and Ashton Dulin as the Colts' top active receivers, with Alec Pierce on IR.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury. The Colts traded Josh Downs and Keenan Allen on Nov 10, so he returns to a thin room whenever his practice window opens.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Kansas City acquired Josh Downs from Indianapolis at the Nov 10 deadline. Downs adds another target competitor to a Chiefs receiver room that already includes Rashee Rice and Xavier Worthy.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Minnesota traded a 2027 third-round pick for Kirk Cousins (from the Raiders) before the Nov 10 deadline, pending a physical. The move replaces the struggling Carson Wentz/Max Brosmer situation, and Yahoo lists Addison as a deadline winner.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) is questionable after missing Week 9, and he stayed with Minnesota through the Nov 10 deadline. The Vikings traded for Kirk Cousins that day, which upgrades his QB play once healthy.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Thomas was not traded at the Nov 10 deadline, when Josh Downs went to Kansas City instead. He stays in Jacksonville coming off a 19-snap, zero-target game on Nov 5.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: No Steelers receiver trade was reported at the Nov 10 deadline, where Downs and Keenan Allen were the only WRs moved. Bernard keeps the WR2 role with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lamar Jackson is on IR, so Baltimore's QBs are Joe Fagnano and Jacoby Brissett, who came over from Arizona at the deadline. Lane had no fantasy points on 32 snaps on Nov 5.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Sleeper lists Brown questionable (knee) as of Nov 11. He sat out Week 9 on Nov 8 after missing every practice that week, and his Wednesday Week 10 participation is the next key indicator.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: With A.J. Brown out on Nov 8, Douglas scored 12.7 half-PPR points on 43 snaps. Brown is questionable (knee) for Week 10, so Douglas stays a top Patriots target if Brown sits again.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Wilson is questionable as of Nov 11. He has been in the concussion protocol since Nov 4, missed the Nov 8 game, and must clear the protocol before Week 10.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Mitchell played 56 snaps at Kansas City on Nov 8 with Garrett Wilson out. Wilson is questionable (concussion) for Week 10, so Mitchell stays the Jets' lead receiver while Wilson is in the protocol.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate is questionable (shoulder) as of Nov 11 after missing Week 8 and then the Titans' Week 9 bye. He is expected back for Week 10 vs. Jacksonville on Nov 15.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Pickens is questionable as of Nov 11. He was inactive with a hamstring injury for the Nov 8 win over Indianapolis after trying to play, and there is no Week 10 practice update yet.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson is questionable (quad) as of Nov 11 after missing two straight games through Nov 8. It is the same quad issue that cost him Weeks 3-5.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) has missed three straight games through Nov 8, and Philadelphia is on bye in Week 10. His earliest return is Week 11.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle suffered a concussion in Denver's Nov 8 win over Carolina. Denver is on bye in Week 10, so he is aiming for the Nov 22 game vs. Las Vegas if he clears the protocol.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring, with a return projected around Week 12. Puka Nacua is now also likely headed to IR (turf toe, MCL/PCL) per NFL.com, so the Rams receiver room is thin until Adams returns.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.note: The Colts traded Downs to the Chiefs on deadline day (Nov 10) for fourth- and fifth-round picks, with a seventh coming back to KC. With Xavier Worthy's hamstring injury he lands in a better passing offense, but he may see limited usage at first while he learns the playbook.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: The Colts traded Allen to the 49ers on Nov 10 for a 2027 sixth-round pick. Analysts see him as short-term insurance while Mike Evans and Ricky Pearsall are hurt, not a reliable rest-of-season WR3.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: The Vikings traded for Kirk Cousins at the Nov 10 deadline, reuniting Jefferson with his former QB. Fantasy analysts call Jefferson the biggest fantasy winner of the deadline.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Kansas City acquired Josh Downs on Nov 10, which adds target competition. Rice is still KC's top receiver while Xavier Worthy (hamstring) is hurt.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Sleeper lists Worthy questionable with a hamstring injury from Nov 8, and Andy Reid has reportedly called him day-to-day. KC's Nov 10 trade for Josh Downs adds competition for targets once he returns.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (knee - mcl) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: The MRI showed MCL and PCL sprains in his right knee plus turf toe, and Sean McVay said on Nov 9 that the Rams expect to place him on IR. He will miss at least four games; the ACL is not believed to be torn.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Sleeper lists Evans questionable (Achilles tendinitis) as of Nov 11 after he missed Week 9. San Francisco's Nov 10 trade for Keenan Allen adds receiver depth while he is out.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season with a neck fracture from the Nov 8 loss to Seattle, Mike LaFleur announced on Nov 9. Sleeper lists him on IR.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden suffered a concussion in the Nov 8 win over Tampa Bay after scoring 17.2 half-PPR points. He must clear the protocol, and Chicago's Week 10 bye gives him extra time.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Sleeper lists Branch doubtful (hamstring) as of Nov 11 after he missed two straight games. No return timeline has been reported.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Sleeper lists Shaheed questionable (knee) as of Nov 11 after he missed his second straight game in Week 9. No return date has been set.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: Sleeper still lists McConkey questionable (back) as of Nov 11, and he recorded no Week 9 stats. Monitor his practice status this week.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot, plantar fasciitis) is still on IR as of Nov 11. Week 10 vs. Cincinnati on Nov 15 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Wilson (finger) is still on IR with no reported return date as of Nov 11.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19, and no practice-window opening has been reported as of Nov 11.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Hill is still an unsigned free agent coming off ACL surgery, and no signing has been reported as of Nov 11.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: With Lamar Jackson on IR, Flowers scored only 3.8 half-PPR points in the Nov 5 loss to Jacksonville with a rookie at QB. His outlook stays poor until Jackson returns.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson reportedly sprained the PCL and MCL in his left knee in Week 9, and on Nov 9 Brian Schottenheimer said he is expected to miss multiple weeks. Dallas has already ruled him out for Week 10 vs. San Francisco.

players.name: Tyler Warren
players.note: At the Nov 10 deadline the Colts traded WR Josh Downs to Kansas City and WR Keenan Allen to San Francisco. That leaves Warren as Indianapolis' clear top option in the passing game.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Kansas City acquired WR Josh Downs from the Colts on deadline day (Nov 10), adding another short-area target alongside Kelce and Rashee Rice. Expect a slight dip in Kelce's target share.

players.name: George Kittle
players.note: San Francisco traded for WR Keenan Allen at the Nov 10 deadline, adding another target competitor for Kittle in the passing game.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson remains on IR (ankle) and also pulled a hamstring in practice on Nov 6. Sean McVay expects him to miss another couple of weeks, so he will not play in Week 10.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.note: The Nov 10 deadline trackers reported no Goedert trade, so he appears to be staying in Philadelphia as the starting TE. That keeps rookie Eli Stowers in a reserve role.

players.name: Joe Milton
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as PHI's starting QB as of 8:00 AM PT Nov 11.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (knee) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 11.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:45 PM PT Nov 11.

players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's backup QB as of 8:00 AM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 5:21 PM PT Nov 8. Earlier: Listed questionable (foot) for Week 9 vs. Chicago despite full practices Thursday and Friday (Nov 5-6). Todd Bowles calls him a game-time decision after he missed the past two games.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 11. Earlier: Sarratt was a healthy inactive for the Nov 5 loss to Jacksonville. Baltimore is down to Joe Fagnano or newly acquired Jacoby Brissett at QB.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 11.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:49 AM PT Nov 8. Earlier: Tyson (hamstring) was limited all week after being designated to return from IR on Nov 4. He is questionable for Sunday vs. Cleveland, and as of Nov 8 there was no confirmed activation or word on the Saints' plans.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 11.

players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 9:45 AM PT Nov 8.
